description: Additive anticoagulant and antiplatelet effect greatly increases bleeding risk
clinical_action: Avoid combination; if necessary monitor INR closely and watch for bleeding

description: NSAIDs inhibit platelet function and can displace warfarin from protein binding increasing bleeding risk
clinical_action: Avoid NSAIDs with warfarin; use paracetamol for pain

description: Ciprofloxacin inhibits CYP1A2 increasing warfarin levels and INR
clinical_action: Monitor INR closely; may need dose reduction

description: Metronidazole inhibits CYP2C9 metabolism of warfarin increasing anticoagulant effect
clinical_action: Monitor INR; reduce warfarin dose if needed

description: CYP3A4 inhibition increases warfarin exposure and bleeding risk
clinical_action: Monitor INR; consider alternative antibiotic

description: Fluoxetine inhibits CYP2C9 increasing warfarin plasma levels
clinical_action: Monitor INR; watch for bleeding signs

description: Dual antiplatelet therapy increases bleeding risk though sometimes clinically intended
clinical_action: Use only if clearly indicated (e.g. ACS); monitor for bleeding

description: Ibuprofen may competitively inhibit aspirin's antiplatelet effect
clinical_action: Separate doses; take aspirin 30 min before ibuprofen

description: Furosemide may increase metformin levels; risk of lactic acidosis
clinical_action: Monitor renal function and metformin levels

description: Corticosteroids cause hyperglycemia opposing metformin's effect
clinical_action: Monitor blood glucose; may need dose adjustment

description: Corticosteroids raise blood glucose countering antidiabetic therapy
clinical_action: Monitor blood glucose frequently

description: Amlodipine inhibits CYP3A4 increasing simvastatin levels and myopathy risk
clinical_action: Limit simvastatin dose to 20mg/day with amlodipine

description: Erythromycin strongly inhibits CYP3A4 greatly increasing simvastatin exposure and rhabdomyolysis risk
clinical_action: Avoid combination; use alternative antibiotic

description: Some fluoroquinolones may affect statin metabolism
clinical_action: Monitor for muscle pain and weakness

description: CYP3A4 inhibition increases atorvastatin levels
clinical_action: Use lowest effective atorvastatin dose; monitor for myopathy

description: Combined serotonergic effect can precipitate serotonin syndrome; fluoxetine also inhibits tramadol metabolism
clinical_action: Avoid; if needed monitor closely for serotonin syndrome symptoms

description: Fluoxetine inhibits CYP2D6 blocking codeine conversion to morphine reducing efficacy and altering toxicity profile
clinical_action: Avoid; use alternative analgesic

description: Serotonin syndrome risk from combined serotonergic action
clinical_action: Avoid combination; use non-serotonergic analgesic

description: Sertraline inhibits CYP2D6 affecting codeine metabolism
clinical_action: Use alternative analgesic

description: Combined CNS and respiratory depression risk; potentially fatal
clinical_action: Avoid combination; if unavoidable use lowest doses and monitor closely

description: Additive CNS depression and respiratory depression risk
clinical_action: Avoid; if required monitor respiratory rate and consciousness

description: Ciprofloxacin inhibits CYP1A2 dramatically increasing theophylline levels risking toxicity (arrhythmias; seizures)
clinical_action: Avoid; use alternative antibiotic or reduce theophylline dose and monitor levels

description: CYP1A2 inhibition increases theophylline levels; toxicity risk
clinical_action: Monitor theophylline levels; reduce dose; consider alternative antibiotic

description: Furosemide causes hypokalemia which increases digoxin toxicity risk
clinical_action: Monitor electrolytes and digoxin levels; replace potassium

description: Antibiotics may alter gut flora increasing digoxin absorption in some patients
clinical_action: Monitor digoxin levels

description: Azithromycin may increase digoxin levels by altering gut metabolism
clinical_action: Monitor digoxin levels; watch for toxicity signs

description: Additive potassium retention causes dangerous hyperkalemia
clinical_action: Monitor potassium levels closely; use with caution

description: Combined potassium retention causes dangerous hyperkalemia
clinical_action: Monitor potassium levels; avoid if renal function is impaired

description: Dual RAAS blockade increases risk of renal failure; hyperkalemia; hypotension
clinical_action: Avoid combination; monitor renal function and electrolytes if used

description: NSAIDs reduce renal lithium clearance increasing lithium toxicity risk
clinical_action: Avoid NSAIDs; use paracetamol; monitor lithium levels

description: Diuretics reduce renal lithium clearance causing toxicity
clinical_action: Monitor lithium levels closely; adjust dose

description: Metronidazole may increase lithium levels
clinical_action: Monitor lithium levels during treatment

description: Fluoxetine inhibits phenytoin metabolism increasing levels and toxicity risk
clinical_action: Monitor phenytoin levels; watch for toxicity

description: Omeprazole may increase phenytoin levels
clinical_action: Monitor phenytoin levels

description: Metronidazole inhibits phenytoin metabolism increasing toxicity risk
clinical_action: Monitor phenytoin levels closely

description: Increased risk of GI ulceration and bleeding
clinical_action: Use gastroprotection; prefer paracetamol for pain

description: PPIs may reduce levothyroxine absorption
clinical_action: Take levothyroxine 30-60 min before PPI

description: Possible minor reduction in levothyroxine absorption
clinical_action: Separate administration times

description: Minor additive CNS effects
clinical_action: Monitor for drowsiness

description: Additive cardiac depression; bradycardia and AV block risk
clinical_action: Monitor heart rate and blood pressure; usually manageable

description: Beta-blockers mask hypoglycemia signs (except sweating)
clinical_action: Educate patient; monitor glucose carefully

description: Corticosteroids cause significant hyperglycemia requiring insulin dose adjustment
clinical_action: Increase insulin monitoring; adjust doses

description: Omeprazole inhibits CYP2C19 reducing clopidogrel activation and antiplatelet effect
clinical_action: Prefer pantoprazole over omeprazole with clopidogrel

description: Minimal CYP2C19 inhibition compared to omeprazole
clinical_action: Preferred PPI choice with clopidogrel

description: Additive QT prolongation increasing arrhythmia risk
clinical_action: Avoid combination; monitor ECG if unavoidable

description: Chloramphenicol inhibits warfarin metabolism causing markedly elevated INR
clinical_action: Monitor INR closely; reduce warfarin dose

clinical_action: Monitor phenytoin levels closely
